Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add core services: Project, Playbook, and Artifact management

Implemented service layer for WP1-WP2:

- ProjectService: Full CRUD operations for bond projects
- PlaybookService: Manages playbook configuration and seeding
- ArtifactService: File upload, storage, and chunk management
- UCS Playbook Data: Complete configuration from playbook v0.2
  - 60+ schema paths with criticality tiers
  - 8 extractor definitions with prompts
  - 17 checklist items across P1-P6 phases
  - 6 readiness dimensions with weights

API endpoints now functional:
- POST /api/v1/playbooks/seed - Initialize UCS playbook
- POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/projects
- POST /api/v1/artifacts/upload - File upload with storage
- GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/chunks

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add document chunking pipeline for PDF and Excel

Implemented WP2 chunking services:

- BaseChunker: Abstract interface with content hashing
- PDFChunker: Page-based extraction using pypdf
  - Preserves page numbers for provenance
  - Detects embedded images
  - Generates content hashes for deduplication
- ExcelChunker: Sheet-based extraction using openpyxl
  - Preserves sheet names
  - Formats content as pipe-delimited tables
- CSVChunker: Single-chunk extraction for CSV files

Updated artifact_tasks.py:
- process_artifact\(\): Full chunking workflow
- Automatic chunker selection based on file type
- Error handling and status tracking
- reprocess_artifact\(\): Re-chunk with fresh logic

Per spec: Chunks are immutable evidence units with preserved provenance.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add Anthropic extraction service for AI-powered fact extraction

Implements WP3 AI Pipelines & Review:
- AnthropicClient: Claude API integration with retry logic and JSON parsing
- ExtractionResponseParser: Converts Claude responses to ParsedFact objects
  with value normalization \(currency, percentage, date, boolean\)
- FactExtractor: Orchestrates extraction from chunks with schema validation
- BatchExtractor: Handles artifact-level extraction with duplicate resolution
- Celery tasks: run_extraction_job, extract_from_artifact, batch_extract
- REST API: POST/GET extraction jobs, retry failed jobs

Evidence-first design maintains full provenance via FactChunkAssociation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add fact management, checklist, and readiness scoring services

Implements core business logic for WP4 \(Review & Approval\):
- FactService: CRUD operations, review workflow \(approve/reject/revise\),
  revision history tracking, conflict detection and auto-resolution
- ChecklistService: Computed status from linked facts, gap analysis,
  phase summaries with P1-P6 progression tracking
- ReadinessService: Dimension scoring \(0-5 per dimension, 0-10 overall\),
  weighted contributions, gap prioritization, recommendation engine

Key features:
- Deterministic status computation per spec \(rules-based, not learned\)
- Full audit trail via FactRevision immutable log
- Evidence linking to checklist items and readiness dimensions
- Prioritized gap reports with suggested evidence types
- Phase completion gating via blocking item checks

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
